dedupe_keys.name: mentions of climatic and natural events in the french national archives since the late 18th century

description: A list of dated and located disasters found in French archive inventories. The data.gouv.fr page says archive files mention many climatic disasters and natural events, often linked to compensation for public or agricultural calamities, and that the dataset lists events with type, description, department (current French departments plus Algeria), year, place, start and end dates (mostly to the month), the archive group, the notice URL and reference. It is free to download under the Licence Ouverte 2.0 and was updated on 27 August 2025, with more extractions planned. Coverage is France from the late 18th century. Caveats: the page says it is not exhaustive, and for the 1950s and 1960s only events with substantial files were kept. For simulation it extends flood, drought, frost and storm records back centuries, for return period and agricultural calamity studies. A related catalogue record is the NFA Taiwan disaster case data.
